༄༅/ /theg pa mchog gi lam gyi rim pa dang mthun par brjod pa'i smon lam byang chub bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /theg pa mchog gi lam gyi rim pa dang mthun par brjod pa'i smon lam byang chub bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

'phags pa kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma mchog gsum dang*/ /yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang 'phags/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung tshogs dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs smon pa 'grub pa'i dbang po mdzod/ /phyag 'tshal mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /myang ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol dge ba rnams/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon te rang gzhan skye 'phags thams cad kyi dge tshogs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdom pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad tshe rabs kun tu yang ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i skye gnas dman pa rnams su nam yang skye bar ma gyur cig khyad par du yang*/ yang sos dang*/ thig nag dang*/ bsdus 'joms dang*/ ngu 'bod dang*/ du 'bod chen po dang*/ tsha ba dang*/ rab tu tsha ba dang*/ mnar med dang bcas pa'i tsha ba'i dmyal ba rnams su nam yang skye bar ma gyur cig chu bur can dang*/ chu bur brdol ba dang*/ so tham tham pa dang*/ kyi hud zer ba dang*/ a chu zer ba dang*/ ut+pal ltar gas pa dang*/ pad+ma ltar gas pa dang*/ pad+ma chen po ltar gas pa dang bcas pa'i grang ba'i dmyal ba rnams su nam yang skye bar ma gyur cigame dmar mur gyi 'obs dang*/ ro myags kyi 'dam dang*/ ral gri'i lo ma'i nags tshal dang*/ chu bo rab med dang*/ shal ma li'i sdong po la sogs pa'i nye 'khor nye tshe ba'i dmyal ba rnams su nam yang skye bar ma gyur cig dmyal bar skyes zin pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las thar par gyur cig bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad phyi'i sgrib pa can dang*/ nang gi sgrib pa can dang*/ me lce'i 'phreng ba can dang*/ mi gtsang ba za ba dang*/ rang sha bcad cing za ba la sogs pa'i yi dwags kyi gnas rnams su nam yang skye bar ma gyur cig

yi dwags kyi su skyes pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang yi dwags kyi skye gnas las thar bar 'gyur cig bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad bdud dang gnod sbyin dang gshin rje dang srin po dang sha za dang 'byung po la sogs pa'i mi ma yin rnams su nam yang skye bar ma gyur cig klu'i rigs dang seṅge dang stag dang dom dred dang 'phar spyang dang glang po che dang rta dang ma he dang ba lang dang rnga mong dang bong bu dang ra lug dang phag dang bya khyi dang byi ba dang sdig sbrul dang nya dang 'bu srin la sogs pa'i dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnams su nam yang skye bar ma gyur cig mi ma yin dang dud 'gror skyes pa'i sems can de thams cad kyang skye gnas de dag las thar bar gyur cig bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad rtag tu bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig mi khom pa brgyad kyi gnas su nam yang mi skye zhing*/ rtag tu dam pa'i chos tshul sgrub nus pa'i lha mi'i rten khyad par can thob par gyur cig rtag tu dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi'i lus rnam par dag pa bar ma chad du thob cing tshe rabs dran par gyur cigatshe rabs thams cad du bslab gsum rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i rab byung gi rten sha stag thob par gyur cig bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes nas de las thar bar 'dod pa'i thar ba don gnyer kyi blo rtsol med du skye bar gyur cigamir skyes kyang yo byad kyis phongs zhing dbul ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar gyur cig tsha grang dang bkres skom dang nad sna tshogs dang gdon sna tshogs kyis gzir ba las thar bar gyur cig bkra mi shis pa dang 'thab rtsod dang nor phyug dang lo nyes pa dang me chu la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las thar bar gyur cig sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal gsum dang*/

dgra gnyen nges med la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal drug dang*/ skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal brgyad las thar bar gyur cig 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu mi dge ba bcu dang mtshams med pa lnga dang rtsa ba dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang des bsags pa'i las kyi kun 'byung gi bden pa rnams las thar bar gyur cigabadag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyang lha min gyi 'jig rten du mi skye zhing lha ma yin 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal las thar bar gyur cigalha'i gnas su skyes kyang 'chi 'pho ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal las thar bar gyur cig mdor na khams gsum 'khor ba na sdug bsngal gyi rigs ji snyed cig 'chis pa'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las thar nas zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa thob par gyur cig bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sems can mtha' dag la dmigs pa'i byams pa dang snying rje chen po rgyun mi chad du skye bar gyur cig snying rjes kun nas bslangs te rang gzhan gyi don du dmigs nas sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur cig sems bskyed nas spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed nus par gyur cig chos dang zang zing gi dngos po gzhan la gtong ba'i sgo nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum gyi sgo nas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs rdzogs par gyur cig gnod pa la ji snyam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang len dang*/ chos la nges sems kyi bzod pa'i sgo nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus kyi sgo nas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig

ji lta ba dang ji snyed la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas kyi sgo nas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin shes pa'i sgo nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig sbyin pa dang tshig snyan pa dang don 'thun pa dang don spyod pa'i bsdu ba bzhi'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig rang nyid sdug bsngal bar gyur kyang bla'i/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed par 'dod pa'i gzhan phan gyi blo nam yang 'dor bar ma gyur cig grangs med pa'i zhing rnams su sna tshogs pa'i sprul pa'i rnam rol gyis sems can mchog dman mtha' dag dang khyad par du ma dag pa'i zhing gi 'gro ba rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa la 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po ci 'dra bar de 'dra bar gyur cigabyang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos smon lam ji lta mdzad pa de 'dra ba'i smon lam rlabs po che ma lus pa 'grub par gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du rgyal ba kun gyi mdo sngags kyi dam pa'i chos ma lus par rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dzin pa la chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa lta bur gyur cigabadag cag la sogs sems can thams cad 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa dang mi 'khrugs pa dang sman gyi bla ma dang nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la sogs pa sangs rgyas byang sems kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong nas lam sna mdzad par gyur cig shi 'phos nas dga' ldan dang mngon dga' 'am bde ba can la sogs pa'i dag pa'i zhing rnam par dag pa nyid du theg pa chen po'i rigs can dbang po rnon po sha stag tu pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar gyur cigader skyes ma thag tu ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs dang spobs pa dang mngon par shes pa dang rdzu 'phrul mchog gi pha rol tu phyin pa thob par gyur cig

dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas rang dbang thob pa na ma dag pa'i zhing du phyin nas de'i sems can rnams gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos ston pa la sogs pa'i thabs tshul sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i lam bzang rnam par dag pa la 'god nus par gyur cig byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad pa'i tshe bya dka' ba'i spyod pa mtha' dag la nam yang mi zhum zhing sgyid lugs pa med par rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son par gyur cig gzhan yang skye ba thams cad du theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis dgyes bzhin du rjes su 'dzin pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig rjes su bzung nas kyang des bstan pa'i mdo sngags kyi dam pa'i chos mtha' dag gi don khong du chud nas don nyams su len cing*/ khyad par du yang rdo rje theg pa'i rim gnyis kyi zab lam nyams su len pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig de ltar mdo sngags kyi zab don kun rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin nyams su blangs nas mar gyur 'gro ba thams cad kyi don du rgyal ba'i go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig bdag gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der ngan song gsum gyi ming yang mi grags shing rnam par dag pa dang snod bcud kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas dag pa'i zhing gzhan du ma las khyad par du 'phags pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas pa'i rgyal ba kun gzigs kyi zhing de lta bur gyur cig rgyal sras smon lam gaṅgā'i klung rnams ni/ /dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam nang 'dus par/ / gsungs phyir dge rtsa ji snyed bsags pa rnams/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngo/ /rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang*/ /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par shog /ces theg pa mchog gi lam gyi rim pa dang mthun par brjod pa'i smon lam byang chub bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di ni/

dad dang blo gros ldan pa tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub kyis rang gzhan la phan pa'i ched du bskul ba'i ngo bor/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub min can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/ par gyi yi ge pa ni bskul ba po nyid do/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/theg pa mchog gi lam gyi rim pa dang mthun par brjod pa'i smon lam byang chub bgrod pa'i them skas bzhugs/ -PAGE 92--PAGE 93--PAGE 87-
